Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
On Thu, 10 Jul 2003 09:13:08 +0200, "Orpheus" <orph...@free.fr>
scrawled:

>If you become Anarch, and then Clan Impersonate a Camarilla Clan, do you
>lose your Anarch Status ? If you had Anarch Counters, do you lose them ?

when you change clan you gain the default sect of the clan.
from the rulebook:

"10. Vampire Sects
...
If a vampire changes clans (by means of a Clan Impersonation
card, for example) to a clan that belongs to a different sect (see
the lists in the following sections), he changes sects as well."

all the effects (currently) that make you an anarch vampire are
'undone' if you change sect. (card texts say to burn Galaric's Legacy
and Go Anarch!, burn Seattle Committee's anarch counters, and from the
cardless action rule as printed in the rulebook "If the anarch changes
sect, then he is no longer anarch.")

salem

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>If you become Anarch, and then Clan Impersonate a Camarilla Clan, do you
>lose your Anarch Status ? If you had Anarch Counters, do you lose them ?

Slight elaboration to previous posts: Yes, unless you Clan Impersonate your
current clan.

An Anarch Ventrue who CI's to Brujah becomes Camarilla and thus loses his
Anarchness. If he CI's to Ventrue instead, he does not change sect because he
does not change sect (and thus maintains his Anarchhood).

Halcyan 2
